notes: Read-only Agent0 subgraph endpoints on The Graph, copied from DEFAULT_SUBGRAPH_URLS in agent0lab/agent0-ts src/core/contracts.ts at commit a6fb48773cdeb02af77cccda2a610ec81049d4b2 (2026-03-16). They carry the public gateway keys that the SDK ships as defaults. Override with AGENT0_SUBGRAPH_URLS='{"8453":"https://..."}' or set GRAPH_API_KEY to use your own key with the same subgraph ids.
